item.name: Payment gateway webhook (not for app clients)

request.name: Payment gateway webhook (not for app clients)

description.content: CALLED BY THE PAYMENT GATEWAY, NOT BY APP CLIENTS. Confirms a payment's outcome: on payment.success the payment becomes SUCCESS and its due becomes PAID; on payment.failed the payment becomes FAILED and the due stays payable. Requests are verified with an HMAC-SHA256 signature over 'event:paymentId:transactionId' using the shared webhook secret, and processing is idempotent — replaying a processed event returns the current state without side effects. Errors: 401 on a bad signature, 404 for an unknown payment, 409 if the event conflicts with an already-terminal payment, 412 if webhooks are not configured.
